title: S1 · E1 · From a chat to an app on every assistant

series.cliffhanger: Orders pour in at golden hour; the assistants have only just started.

hook.what: Customers walk past the shop with phones out; caption 'Customers ask their assistants.' The street moves from the first frame.

promise.what: Mara's counter is empty while the street is full. The viewer wants to know how she gets those customers.

openLoops.what: Why does a customer walk away? A customer's assistant says it cannot order from the shop (drawn chat, 'empty' scene).
Will Jun's chat produce anything? The request is typed; 'From a chat to an app.'
Does the app work for an assistant? A real recording shows an assistant placing order TT-1001; caption 'Every assistant can order.'

reHooks.what: Door bell: Jun arrives (new scene, new character).
The app appears on the phone (real screen, chime, music lift).
The rush: three orders in a row, ping each.
Music dips, then lifts into the payoff.

payoff.what: A busy shop at golden hour and the orders list; then the end card 'Every assistant can use your app.'

retention.trailer: Next on Shipvo (E2, The first update): follow-up issue; not part of this cut.
retention.cliffhanger: Orders keep coming; E2 asks what happens when something goes wrong at the busiest hour.
